steps.en: Install the skill and provide Python plus FFmpeg
steps.zh: 安装技能，准备 Python 和 FFmpeg

steps.en: Provide your clip and request orbit at seconds 3 to 6
steps.zh: 提供视频，请求第 3 到第 6 秒环绕

steps.en: Write the timing plan and inspect rendered sample frames
steps.zh: 写时间计划，检查渲染的示例帧

steps.en: Track the face, mask the person and export the effects MP4
steps.zh: 跟踪人脸，用人物遮罩合成并导出 MP4

steps.en: Watch and approve the finished effect pass
steps.zh: 观看并批准完成的效果视频

value.en: A face-relative effect pass without hand-keyframing every moving card
value.zh: 不用逐张卡片手调关键帧，得到跟脸的效果视频
